verdict.rationale: Wave's docs confirm you can create bills, and receipt scanning uses OCR to extract data, which covers part of the capture step. Nothing in the evidence shows approval routing or scheduling vendor payments. The payments features described are all receivables-side, so most of the AP workflow is unevidenced. Missing for 10: bill approval routing/workflow, scheduled vendor bill payments, OCR capture of vendor bills specifically (not just receipts), a unified capture-approve-pay workflow, independent corroboration.
